/* ============================================================
   GOLD LAYER – EXTERNAL TABLE CREATION SCRIPT
   Azure Synapse Dedicated SQL Pool
   Source: gold schema views (OPENROWSET → Silver)
   Target: Gold container via CTAS
   Format: Parquet + Snappy
   ============================================================ */


/* ============================================================
   Calendar Dimension
   ============================================================ */
CREATE EXTERNAL TABLE GOLD.EXTCALENDAR
WITH (
    LOCATION = 'EXTCALENDAR/',
    DATA_SOURCE = GoldDataSource,
    FILE_FORMAT = ParquetFileFormat
)
AS
SELECT * FROM gold.calendar;


/* ============================================================
   Customers Dimension
   ============================================================ */
CREATE EXTERNAL TABLE GOLD.EXTCUSTOMERS
